facts.fact: The Unlocking Data Initiative Malawi team is developing an Education Data Portal (EDaP) to bring together datasets from the education ministry (MoEST, which runs the EMIS), the gender and social welfare ministry, the National Statistics Office, development partners and academia, with hosting to pass to CERT at the University of Malawi.
